title: POP Info Channels Common Page
summary: Official Derivative common page anchor for POP info channels, linking POP operators to Info CHOP inspection patterns and the common POP info-channel sections found on operator pages.
guidance: Use this article as a common-page anchor when a POP plan needs runtime inspection through Info CHOP.
The public common page is intentionally sparse; read the operator-specific Info CHOP Channels section on each POP card or official operator page for concrete channel names.
Use Info CHOP alongside POP validation when checking cook health, warnings, errors, dimensions, counts, or operator-specific diagnostics.
Keep POP info-channel guidance distinct from Common Operator Info Channels, which are listed on individual operator pages.
